name: xRocket Exchange MCP
tagline: Live xRocket markets plus autonomous-trading setup under one daily limit
description: A credential-free hosted MCP for xRocket spot-market snapshots, symbols, tickers, candles, order books, trades, asset rates, fees, and trading onboarding. The remote profile is read-only; users who want an agent to trade generate a local configuration with one operator-set daily value limit. Transfers and withdrawals remain separately disabled unless explicitly enabled.

install.notes: The hosted profile is public and never accepts account credentials. Use its trading setup link or onboarding tool to generate a local testnet-first configuration; never enter an xRocket API token into the remote MCP.
